facts.fact: 1943 年墨西哥城，骗子 Ulises 身无分文，正要在两个通信对象之间做选择：Monclova 的寡妇或 Veracruz 小镇 Puerco Ahogado 的老处女。
facts.anchor: He was going to make a choice, either the widow from Mon-clova or the spinster from that town in Veracruz. Puerco Ahogado, that was the name of it.

facts.fact: 他父亲是老骗子，三年前病死；父亲的犯罪天赋他没继承到，积蓄也被父亲的病掏空，如今独自谋生漂泊无依。
facts.anchor: But after three years now without his father, he was rudderless, hardly able to remain afloat.

facts.fact: 上一个骗局：Jalisco 寡妇 Cornelia Aguirre，骗她投资不存在的 Acapulco 酒店开发被她三个儿子搅局，他只拎一只箱子逃走；寡妇送的相机他此刻卖给皮条客 Moisés，并拒绝其入伙邀请。
facts.anchor: When the widow Aguirre discovered that there was no hotel development in Acapulco, she’d promptly gone into hysterics.

facts.fact: 二战时局：墨西哥城有 Camacho 总统组织的灯火管制演习；此前上流社会亲德、Vasconcelos 在 Timón 称颂希特勒，如今风向转亲美。
facts.anchor: It was another of the drills President Camacho had organized. Apagones.

facts.fact: 抉择落点是钱：去 Puerco Ahogado 的火车票更便宜，他选了 Veracruz 的老处女 Perla Inclán。
facts.anchor: In the end, his decision came down to money: the ticket to Puerco Ahogado, Veracruz, was cheaper.

facts.fact: 他化名 Mr. Linares 坐火车赴约，在站台上被吃冰淇淋的男孩弄脏米色西装；来接站的是 Miss Inclán 派的 Fito，车因故障迟到。
facts.anchor: Hello, sir, Miss Inclán sent me to pick you up. Sorry I’m late, the car wouldn’t start this morning.

facts.fact: 宅中先遇侄女 Inés——目光大胆、出言不逊，他立刻断定这不是女佣；Perla 一身鸽灰、戴银十字架，被撩得脸红随即恢复冷淡；他被安排进蝴蝶室。
facts.anchor: Her lack of deference established her identity. This was no housemaid.

facts.fact: 房客只有三拨：Zorrilla 家两姐妹与 Nepomuceno 教授；Perla 之父 Osorio Inclán 是昔日 Inclán 咖啡公司老板，宅子已衰败挂牌招租，他掂量这座房子值不值得下手。
facts.anchor: Manuela and Eduviges Zorrilla. And Professor Nepomuceno.
